Climate Disasters Increase Amidst Program Funding Cuts

The frequency and intensity of climate-related disasters are increasing, coinciding with reductions in funding for programs designed to prepare for such events. This trend is observed across various regions, highlighting a growing vulnerability to climate impacts.
